craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of glory in gear — hand-and-emblem song. Wild-One vocative per UNC (uḍḍāmara); triple-split heard standing. Rejected: (a) wild→fierce → killed raw. Read aloud: LUTE, BELL, DRUM … STAND-ing AM-I.

lines: Lute, bell, drum — wild One, playing — this You show;
triple-split work-sound hearing, standing am I.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vīṇāghaṇtāḍamarūn uḍḍāmara vādayann idaṃ diśasi vṛttitribhedabhinnaṃ nādaṃ śṛṇvan sthito 'smīti

reads_against.argmap: What sound is heard standing? → Played triple-split sound heard standing.
c1_essence: Taken rest in mass; pretext commands.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of enacted glory; vīra of uprooted fears; vīra of shattered Māyā; vīra of commanded rest; nāda-vīra of heard sound; vīra of mirrored gods; vīra of borne thunderbolt; vīra of tamed world; vīra of pointed splitting; vīra of proclaimed abode
